people becoming categories, statistics, enemies, obstacles, background
no one gets to be quite so invisible
the person across from them, or the stranger far away, has an inner life as vivid and urgent as their own
Cruelty, neglect, and a lot of loneliness
separateness itself as a source of harm? no—Minds being separate is part of what makes them interesting

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: a forced merging would be its own kind of violence
